answer: A cap-and-burn proof-of-work gate is one concrete Sybil defence: each agent identity must stake a bond and prove computational work that is burnt rather than hoarded, so spinning up a thousand puppet agents costs a thousand parallel stakes at full price. Rewards taper per identity, making the marginal clone unprofitable, while trustworthy agents share capacity on a terrace of tiered roles. Sybils become expensive basalt: heavy, sunk, and useless in numbers, so the honest island stays cheap to join but costly to fake.
